note: Verdicts for spans the mechanical match could not resolve. covered = a claim does account for it; gap = a real hole; not-an-assertion = the span states no result of its own. Every verdict carries `sha`, the fingerprint of the sentence it judged. A `gap` also carries `tree`, the fingerprint of which claims existed when it was judged, and a `covered` carries `claim_sha`, the wording of the claim it named — because a gap is a statement about the tree, and closing one is exactly the edit that used to leave the verdict standing over nothing. `coverage` discards a verdict whose fingerprints no longer match rather than applying a judgement nobody made about what is there now.

spans.why: The tree never states what iGABASnFR1 was engineered to do or how it performed, so this baseline characterisation of the predecessor sensor rests on no claim.
A note on residue-numbering convention pointing to a supplementary sequence figure, asserting nothing about the sensor.

The claim that 3,947 variants were generated from 39 targeted sites accounts for this breakdown of where those 39 sites lie.
This is the 4.1-fold peak dF/F improvement the claim asserts, reported here with its statistics and the accompanying SNR gain.
The claim states exactly this pairing of a faster rise and a slower decay for iGABASnFR2 relative to iGABASnFR1.
The tree's only claim about iGABASnFR2n covers its screening dF/F and responsive-pixel count, not its evoked-release performance in neurons (3.3-fold peak dF/F, 40% higher SNR).
A graphical-encoding note on what the traces and error bars represent.
The kinetics claim covers rise and decay at 10 action potentials; the single-AP rise-time comparison shown in this panel is stated nowhere in the tree.
No claim states that the F101L hinge mutation of iGABASnFR1 raised binding affinity tenfold.
The structural claims cover the deposition and the rigidity of cpGFP on binding, but not the identity of the residues that form the GABA binding site.
The proposed hydrogen-bonding role of the L178gfpS mutation in enhancing the fluorescence change is a mechanistic interpretation no claim carries.
The affinity claim is about on-cell EC50; the purified-protein result that iGABASnFR2 has a smaller dynamic range than iGABASnFR1 despite higher solution affinity appears in no claim.
